sentences.en: ANDREW: Excuse me, I was told to come here for advice about, erm, Management Diploma courses?
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 打扰一下，我被告知来这里咨询有关管理学文凭课程的事？

sentences.en: MONICA: You've certainly come to the right place.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 您确实来对地方了。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Monica.
sentences.zh: Hi，我叫莫妮卡。

sentences.en: ANDREW: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 很高兴见到您。

sentences.en: My name is Andrew, Andrew Harris.
sentences.zh: 我叫安德鲁，安德鲁·哈里斯。

sentences.en: MONICA: So, Andrew, have you seen our diploma course prospectus yet?
sentences.zh: MONICA: 那么，安德鲁，您已经看过我们文凭课程的招生简章了吗？

sentences.en: ANDREW: Yes, I've already looked at it.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 是的，我已经看过了。

sentences.en: In fact, I thought the information on course content was really useful, but I'm afraid I'm a bit confused by all the different ways you
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得课程内容方面的信息非常有用，但很抱歉，我对你们提供的各种修读方式——比如全日制强化课程、兼职课程等等——感到有些困惑。

sentences.en: can do the course: full-time intensive, part-time and so on.
sentences.zh: 您可以通过多种方式完成该课程：全日制强化、兼职等等。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Test l Well, let's see if I can help. think each course type has its advantages and 7. 31 P0
sentences.zh: MONICA: 好吧，让我们看看我能否帮上忙。我认为每种课程形式都有其优势和劣势，因此这实际上取决于您个人——您的学习习惯，当然还有您的经济状况。

sentences.en: MONICA: disadvantages, so it really depends on you - your own study habits, and your-agC.com financial circumstances, of course.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 优势和劣势，所以这真的取决于您——您自己的学习习惯，以及您的经济状况，当然。

sentences.en: Are you working at the moment?
sentences.zh: 你目前在工作吗？

sentences.en: ANDREW: Yes.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 是的。

sentences.en: I've been working in the administration section of the local hospital for the last three years.
sentences.zh: 过去三年，我在当地医院的行政部门工作。

sentences.en: And before that I worked in the office of a computer engineering company for two years.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我在一家计算机工程公司的办公室工作了两年。

sentences.en: So, I've got about five years of relevant work experience.
sentences.zh: 因此，我大约有五年相关工作经验。

sentences.en: And what I'm hoping to focus on is Personnel Management.
sentences.zh: 而我希望重点学习的是人事管理。

sentences.en: MONICA: I see.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 明白了。

sentences.en: And are you planning to leave your current job to study, or are you thinking about just taking a year off?
sentences.zh: 那么，您是打算辞去目前的工作去学习，还是只考虑休学一年呢？

sentences.en: ANDREW: I want to know what my options are, really.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 我其实只是想了解一下自己有哪些选择。

sentences.en: I don't want to quit my job or anything and my employers are keen for me to get some more qualifications but obviously, it would be better if I could do a course without taking too much time away from work.
sentences.zh: 我并不想辞职之类，而且我的雇主也很希望我获得一些更高层次的资质认证；但显然，如果我能选一门无需占用太多工作时间的课程，那就更好了。

sentences.en: MONICA: Right, so you don't really want to do the full-time course, then?
sentences.zh: MONICA: 好的，那么您其实并不想报读全日制课程，对吗？

sentences.en: ANDREW: No, not really.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 是的，确实不太想。

sentences.en: It's also a question of finances.
sentences.zh: 另外，这也是一个资金问题。

sentences.en: You see, my office have agreed to pay the cost of the course itself, but I would have to take unpaid leave if I want to study full-time and, well, I don't think I could afford to support myself with no salary for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 您知道，我的单位已同意承担课程本身的费用，但如果我想全日制学习，我就必须申请无薪休假；而坦白说，我无法承受整整一年没有薪水来维持生计。

sentences.en: MONICA: OK.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, you have two other possibilitics: you could either do the part-time course that would be over two years and you wouldn't have to take any time off work• or you could do what we call a 'modular' course.
sentences.zh: 那么，您还有另外两种选择：一种是为期两年的兼职课程，您无需请假；另一种是我们称之为‘模块化’的课程。

sentences.en: You could do that in eighteen months if you wanted or longer, it's quite flexible and it would be up to you.
sentences.zh: 如果您愿意，可以在十八个月内完成该课程，也可以更久些，课程安排相当灵活，完全由您决定。

sentences.en: ANDREW: Mmm.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what does the part-time course involve?
sentences.zh: 那么兼职课程具体包括哪些内容呢？

sentences.en: MONICA: For that you would join an evening class and have a lecture twice a week.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 对于这种课程，您需参加晚间班，每周上两次讲座。

sentences.en: Then, you'd have to attend a seminar or discussion workshop one weekend a month.
sentences.zh: 然后，您每月还需参加一次周末的研讨会或讨论工作坊。

sentences.en: ANDREW: What kind of coursework would have to do?
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 那么，我需要完成哪些课程作业呢？

sentences.en: MONICA: Well, it's a mixture.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 呃，形式比较多样。

sentences.en: You'd be expected to write an essay each month; which counts towards your final assessment.
sentences.zh: 您需每月撰写一篇论文，该论文将计入最终考核成绩。

sentences.en: You have a case study to do by the end 024/025 of the course, which might involve doing a survey or something like that, and also you need to hand in a short report every four weeks.
sentences.zh: 课程结束前，您还需完成一项案例研究，可能涉及开展一项调查之类的工作；此外，您还需每四周提交一份简短报告。

sentences.en: ANDREW: So, that's quite a lot of work, then, on top of working every day.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 那么，这在每天上班之外，工作量就相当大了。

sentences.en: It sounds like a lot of studying - and really tiring.
sentences.zh: 听起来学习任务繁重——而且真的很累人。

sentences.en: MONICA: Yes, you certainly wouldn't have much free time!
sentences.zh: MONICA: 是的，您确实不会有多少空闲时间！

sentences.en: ANDREW: What about the 'modular' course?
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 那‘模块化’课程呢？

sentences.en: What would I have to do for that?
sentences.zh: 我需要为此做些什么呢？

sentences.en: MONICA: That's where you get the opportunity to study full-time for short periods.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 这种课程让您有机会进行短期的全日制学习。

sentences.en: That way you can cover a lot of coursework and attend lectures and seminars during the day.
sentences.zh: 这样，您便可在白天集中完成大量课程作业，并参加讲座和研讨会。

sentences.en: And each module lasts for one term, say, about twelve weeks at a time.
sentences.zh: 而且每个模块持续一个学期，比如说，每次大约十二周。

sentences.en: There are obvious advantages in this - the main one being that you can study in a much more intensive way, which suits some people much better.
sentences.zh: 这样做显然有诸多优势——最主要的优势在于，你可以以更加集中的方式进行学习，这种方式更适合某些人。

sentences.en: ANDREW: And how many of these 'modules' would I have to do to get the diploma?
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 那么，我要完成多少个这样的‘模块’才能获得该文凭呢？

sentences.en: MONICA: The current programme is two modules - and then you have to choose a topic to work in more depth but you can base that on your job, and so you don't need to be away from the office, and how long it takes is up to you.
sentences.zh: MONICA: 当前的课程设置包含两个模块；之后，你还需要选择一个主题进行更深入的研究，但你可以将该主题与你的工作相结合，因此你无需离开办公室；至于所需时间，则由你自己决定。

sentences.en: It would be more expensive, though.
